ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended (implementing EU Directive 2018/843/5AMLD and 2018/1673/6AMLD); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE Law); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 13 January 2019 on the content and submission of beneficial ownership declarations; CSSF Regulation No. 20-10 and CSSF Circular 18/655.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passports and proof of residential address of each individual UBO, director, and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public, embassy, or competent municipal authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of criminal record (Bulletin No. 3 or equivalent) for each proposed manager/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Prosecutor's Office (Parquet) or national criminal records authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Corporate Existence for any corporate founder or shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Trade Register or Companies Registry of the founding company's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Articles of Association (Statuts) and notarized corporate resolution authorizing incorporation proceedings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg notary public and corporate board of the founding entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign signatures; notarization in Luxembourg for final deed

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, shareholders, contractual counterparties, and beneficial owners of fleet financing against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit (CRF) warnings; mandatory PEP classification at national, EU, and international institutional levels with enhanced due diligence for high-risk PEPs; ongoing adverse-media and sanctions re-screening at minimum every 90 days and before each bank wire transfer under CSSF AML/CFT obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), accessible at https://www.lbr.lu and https://www.rcs.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Latin-alphabet characters; French is the prevailing statutory language of the RCS, with German and English commonly accepted; Lux Type required legal-form suffix 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or abbreviation 'S.à r.l.' must be appended; non-Latin transliterations are not recognized for registration and the name must not be misleading as to the corporate form, activity, or link to public authorities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In case of rejection, the applicant shall submit a written administrative appeal to the Luxembourg Business Registers stating the name reference number and grounds for reconsideration within 15 days of notification; if rejected at administrative level, the applicant may bring an annulment action before the Administrative Tribunal (Tribunal administratif) within 3 months of the denial notification; interim suspension may be requested by urgent procedure (référé administratif), and expansion/alternate names may re-enter the 30-day reservation cycle without penalty.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as ancillary correspondence address; not compliant as sole registered office because a road freight transport license (Ministry of Mobility and Public Works) and a customs bonded warehouse authorization (Luxembourg Customs and Excise Agency) demand an identified physical operational seat in Luxembourg with staffing and terminals; a letterbox-only address would be deemed absence of commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: quantified 85% likelihood of unannounced customs physical inspection of bonded truck parking, cargo sealing points, and GPS tracking infrastructure within the first 12 months of licensing; additional routine on-site inspections by the Ministry of Mobility for the community operator license.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and 30-day RCS name reservation filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official LBR tariff: no statutory charge for name reservation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Compulsory notarization of incorporation deed (Statuts) and legal-form certificate for SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg notary public in the district of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff scale (Ministère de la Justice) benchmarked at EUR 1,000 net of VAT

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS commercial registration and RESA official gazette publication fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: LBR statutory schedule: EUR 75 registration fee plus EUR 120 RESA publication fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial Owner (RBE) register electronic filing with certified UBO extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory exemption: RBE filing is free of charge when submitted online by the notary or approved domiciliation agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille procurement for foreign UBO, manager, and corporate founder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs or designated competent authority in each country of document issuance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Apostille Convention per-document fee of EUR 10–20 plus courier and translation charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and EU consolidated sanctions screening subscription for all UBOs and managers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Qualified AML compliance data provider (WorldCheck, LexisNexis, or equivalent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark annual subscription per screened individual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and correspondence address provider service for SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of EUR 300–500 per annum for corporate domiciliation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary legal opinion on road feeder transport license and customs bonded status pre-filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Luxembourg attorney (avocat) or accredited customs agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing civil-law market benchmark for transaction-specific advisory engagement

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as consolidated; Article 710-1 et seq. (formation of SARL), Article 710-9 (minimum capital and paid-up capital requirements), as amended by the Law of 23 August 2016 modernizing S.A. and S.à r.l. and subsequent corporate-law reforms.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers, Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation (acte constitutif) and articles of association (statuts) filed electronically through MyGuichet.lu.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital EUR 12,000 (approximately USD 13,000), fully subscribed and fully paid up before RCS registration; share capital must be deposited in a Luxembourg or EEA credit institution in a blocked account, with the notary obtaining a blocking certificate evidencing availability of funds.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the company, having received the share subscriptions and capital contribution evidenced by the blocking certificate, hereby adopts and accepts the issued shares as fully paid per the articles. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at [street address], L-xxxx Luxembourg, and the manager may complete all registrations with the Luxembourg Business Registers. RESOLVED, that [full name] is appointed manager (gérant), acting solely or jointly, with authority to represent the company, operate its bank accounts, submit tax and social-security declarations, and apply for all transport, customs, and environmental permits. RESOLVED, that any ancillary filing required to ensure legal existence and operational capacity is approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bank or credit institution licensed by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked pre-incorporation bank account in the name of the future SARL. Transfer the full subscribed minimum capital of EUR 12,000. Obtain from the bank a blocking certificate addressed to the Luxembourg notary, confirming that the funds are credited and frozen until RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Completed corporate account opening application
Valid passport or national identity card of each founder and manager
Proof of residential address of each founder and manager
Curriculum vitae and source-of-wealth statement for each beneficial owner
Draft articles of association and provisional corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries or rejects the application due to KYC/AML ambiguity, submit supplementary source-of-wealth documentation and a written explanation of the business purpose; alternatively, select another CSSF-licensed bank and restart the blocked-account procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Deed of Incorporation and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg civil-law notary appointed through the Chamber des Notaires du Luxembourg.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the notary after the bank blocking certificate is issued. Review the draft articles and any shareholders' agreement. Appear before the notary for execution of the deed of incorporation. The notary verifies the capital certificate, the capacity of founders, and the absence of statutory disqualifications of managers, then issues the authentic instrument and initiates the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Bank blocking certificate for the share capital
Draft articles of association reviewed by the notary
Passport or national ID of each founder and manager
Statutory declaration of no criminal record for each manager
Power of attorney if a founder is represented
Beneficial ownership information form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies deficiencies in the draft articles, beneficial ownership data, or legal capacity, the founders may execute a rectified deed or provide a compliant declaration; any notarial delay is cured by rescheduling execution once the outstanding document is filed with the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés via MyGuichet.lu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary files the authentic deed and annexes through the LBR electronic filing system. The registry verifies statutory completeness, allocates an RCS registration number, and publishes a legal extract. After registration, file the beneficial owner declaration with the RCS Luxembourg Ultimate Beneficial Ownership register (REBECO).
required_dossiers: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation
Signed articles of association and annexes
List of managers with specimen signatures
Declaration of the subscribed and paid-up share capital
Certificate from the blocked-capital bank account
Acceptance letter for the registered office address
REBECO beneficial ownership filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or rejection, the notary or authorized counsel may submit a supplementary filing rectifying the clerical omission, translation defect, or signature form; if the capitalization certificate is stale, obtain a newer bank confirmation and re-file within the RCS remedial window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, Employer and Social Security Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l’enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) and Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File for Luxembourg VAT (TVA) registration on MyGuichet.lu using the RCS registration data. Submit a separate application to the CCSS for employer registration for social security of the manager and future staff. Provide the company financial information and address to the AEDT for tax number issuance.
required_dossiers: RCS extract issued by Luxembourg Business Registers
Notarial deed of incorporation
Identity documents of the manager and all directors
Registered office confirmation
Bank details of the company
Projected activity description and anticipated VAT status
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT or CCSS queries the application, correct the entity data through the online self-service portal and attach the RCS extract again; if late submission penalties arise, make a voluntary rectification and file a reasoned waiver request with the relevant administration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Professional Transport Operator License and Customs Accreditation Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Mobility and Public Works – Directorate of Road Transport and Logistics, and the Luxembourg Customs and Excise Agency (Administration des douanes et accises).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the road transport operator application under Regulation (EC) No 1071/2009, including the transport manager certificate of professional competence. Simultaneously request AEO authorisation status and customs warehousing/bonded transport documentation for airport feeder operations. The registration becomes effective for legally operating the customs-bonded truck fleet after the license certificate is issued.
required_dossiers: RCS extract and articles of association
Proof of financial standing (audited accounts or bank guarantee)
Certificate of professional competence (CPC) for the transport manager
Criminal record certificate of the transport manager
Evidence of establishment and registered office in Luxembourg
Detailed fleet description and customs bonding capacity plan
Customs security and safety AEO self-assessment questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licensing authority issues a query, supply the clarified financial statements or CPC documentation within the stated deadline; if customs accreditation is deferred, remedy the security checklist and request a second on-site assessment through the customs zone manager.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Mobility and Public Works – Directorate of Road Transport and Logistics, in coordination with the Ministry of the Economy for establishment permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Luxembourg Community Road Transport Operator Licence (Autorisation d’établissement de transporteur routier de marchandises) and Customs AEO/Bonded transport authorisation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l’Environnement, Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 environmental registration under the Luxembourg classified installations regime; full EIA is not required unless the bonded truck fleet facility includes fuel storage above 50,000 litres, truck repair workshops with solvent processes, or cargo handling areas triggering Annex II thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Fleet must comply with Euro VI emission standards under EU Regulation 595/2009; wastewater discharges must meet Luxembourg limit values for chemical oxygen demand, hydrocarbons, and suspended solids; VOC emissions from any maintenance and cleaning activity must stay below the applicable 10 mg/m3 threshold and follow EU Directive 2010/75/EU best available techniques.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Corps grand-ducal d’incendie et de secours (CGDIS) for parking, loading bays, and any fuel storage; structural load inspection report by an approved ingenieur-conseil for warehouse and dock floors; workplace occupancy and occupational health clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) competent for corporate income tax, net wealth tax and municipal business tax, and Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED) competent for VAT and registration duties; joint online filing through Guichet.lu / MyGuichet.lu portal and eCDF electronic filing system
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must first obtain a Luxembourg business registration number (matricule) from the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) through MyGuichet.lu, then file the standard VAT identification form (Formulaire 640) with the AED; non-established taxable persons must appoint a Luxembourg VAT representative and are subject to mandatory VAT registration without a turnover threshold; the issued VAT identification number follows the format LU followed by 8 digits
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election is available for an SARL; statutory elections include (i) VAT grouping under Article 5(7) of the Luxembourg VAT Law to create a single taxable person, (ii) joint taxation of qualifying 75% group companies under Article 164bis LIR, and (iii) election of the EU OSS/IOSS simplification regimes; hybrid mismatch elections are constrained by the Luxembourg ATAD implementation

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual turnover threshold for the resident small-business exemption; non-established foreign suppliers making taxable supplies in Luxembourg must register mandatorily without any threshold unless the supply is subject to reverse charge or covered by the EU OSS return mechanism
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping or continuous transaction control mandate applies in Luxembourg; B2B e-invoicing is optional under standard EU VAT rules, while B2G e-invoicing for public contracts is mandatory through the national PEPPOL-based e-invoicing platform; SAF-T reporting is the accepted electronic audit standard

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under Article 56 of the Luxembourg VAT Law to goods physically exported outside the EU upon production of proof of dispatch and exit; ancillary transport services, including GPS-sealed bonded truck feeder services, qualify under Article 44(1)(h) where directly linked to international transport of goods or to an EU customs export/transit procedure (e.g., TIR or NCTS transit); the service must be rendered for the benefit of the importer/exporter or transport principal
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD) or transit declaration with proof of exit from the EU
CMR International Consignment Note (Convention on the Contract for the International Carriage of Goods by Road)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill for the underlying international shipment
GPS sealing records and unbroken customs seal certificates evidencing bonded movement integrity
Customs bonded warehouse or authorized consignor/consignee authorization reference
Commercial invoice, transport contract and bank payment / inward remittance certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Unjustified export zero-rating is clawed back by the AED together with default interest calculated from the original return due date; fraudulent claims are prosecuted as VAT fraud under Article 14 of the Law of 10 August 1992, carrying imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years and fines of EUR 250 to EUR 25,000 per count, plus revocation of customs carrier and bonded warehouse authorizations and senior management criminal exposure

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) under the Eurosystem framework of the European Central Bank (ECB); conduct supervision of banking and payment institutions is exercised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg applies unrestricted convertibility for both current account and capital account operations pursuant to Articles 63-65 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. The euro is fully convertible, and no exchange control approval is required for profit remittance, dividend distributions, loan servicing, or capital repatriation by a Luxembourg SARL. Any procedural constraint arises solely from EU AML/tax transparency rules and the Luxembourg balance of payments statistical reporting regime, not from convertibility restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion requirement applies to export proceeds in Luxembourg. The SARL may retain export earnings in EUR or any permitted foreign currency. Export-related settlements are subject only to the BCL balance of payments monthly reporting obligations for transactions at or above EUR 50,000 in aggregate, and to standard commercial documentation retention under VAT and customs rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État, Luxembourg (Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Current Account (EUR and multi-currency) and Dedicated Capital Escrow Account
Operational Corporate Account with SWIFT-connected clearing and FX facility
Operational Trade Settlement Account and short-term liquidity line
Operational Current Account and Documentary Credit Facility
Operational Account for SME and trade-related payments

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium. Only EEA-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) holding a passport into Luxembourg under the EU Payment Services Directive (PSD2) may provide EUR-denominated payment accounts and clearing services. Offshore digital EMIs based in third countries are materially constrained: they cannot provide Luxembourg IBANs, cannot access TARGET2 directly, and are not recognized as eligible settlement institutions by the BCL. EMI accounts are limited to payment services and are not suitable for custody, escrow, documentary credit, or material treasury liquidity. For primary operating treasury, a Tier-1 domestic bank remains mandatory.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for the first corporate account opening at most leading Luxembourg banks; at minimum, a designated director or authorized signatory with a board mandate must appear in person at the bank's premises for a KYC interview. Some banks permit a videoconference interview subject to enhanced due diligence and prior relationship, but non-resident directors presenting higher risk profiles will normally be required to attend in Luxembourg. Remote opening is not a right under Luxembourg law and remains at the final discretion of the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of initial capital contribution from foreign parent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide audited group financial statements, a consolidated organizational chart, the parent's board resolution approving the capital contribution, bank statements of the remitting entity, share subscription agreements, and clear evidence that the contribution is recorded in the SARL's statutory accounts as share capital or shareholder loan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance for a Luxembourg road-freight services SARL
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a substance file containing lease agreement for registered office, local management mandates, minutes of annual general meetings, payroll evidence or payroll service provider contracts, vehicle parking and maintenance agreements, GPS fleet telematics summary, commercial contracts with airlines and customs agents, and a realistic staffing and revenue projection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Customs-bonded logistics transactions raising ambiguity on beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Produce the customs authorization or NCTS transit license, transport and freight forwarding contracts, CMR / air waybills, issued and received invoices, customs warehouse or bonded truck agreement, insurance coverage certificates, and a complete register of all ultimate beneficial owners (%25 or higher) filed with the Luxembourg Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (LBR).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border disbursements for fleet acquisition without supporting trade documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble signed purchase agreements for trucks and trailers, pro-forma and commercial invoices, export licenses or safety certificates, financing agreements, transfer-pricing documentation if intra-group, bank-approved payment purpose codes, and an explanation of clearing and settlement timelines.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol for inbound EUR wires: use SWIFT MT103 from the parent company via a correspondent or SEPA Credit Transfer for smaller amounts. The payment must reference the underlying purpose code under BCL balance of payments statistics, typically 'Direct investment – Subscription/contribution to equity' (ESS 310) or 'Loans between affiliated enterprises' (ESS 321). To pass bank compliance, provide the executed loan or subscription agreement, group resolution, an estimated treasury cash-flow plan, and professional source-of-funds evidence. All transfers above EUR 10,000 require accurate ordering information; EU Regulation 2023/1113 on information accompanying transfers must be complied with.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For travel of trade settlements, the SARL should operate through Luxembourg SWIFT-connected banks using MT103 messages with ISO 20022 remittance details. Clearing rails available: SEPA Credit Transfer for intra-EUR payments, SWIFT MT103 for extra-EU supplier payments, and commercial letters of credit issued or confirmed by a Luxembourg bank for high-value fleet and fuel procurement. Each disbursement must be matched to underlying invoices, transport contracts, and customs documentation. For suppliers in USD, GBP, or other non-EUR currencies, a EUR-USD, EUR-GBP, or EUR-XXX FX conversion should be pre-booked with the bank or executed at a transparent market rate to maintain expected cost discipline.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forward contracts (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF) up to 12 months
FX swaps / swap rollovers for short-term liquidity matching
Cross-currency swaps for long-term financing liabilities denominated in foreign currency
European-style FX options (call/put) limited to underlying transaction exposure
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts only for currency pairs without liquid onshore forwards, subject to bank internal policy
Regulated exchange-traded futures on EU regulated markets (Eurex, ICE Europe) for EUR crosses

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts (financial statements) of the SARL comprising balance sheet, profit and loss account and annex
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of the balance-sheet date; shareholders must approve within 6 months and filing with the RCS must occur within 1 month after approval. For a calendar-year SARL: approval by 30 June and filing by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: RCS reminder and judicial summons; court may impose coercive fines and directors/managers are exposed to criminal fines up to EUR 25,000; persistent non-filing can trigger court-ordered strike-off or dissolution of the SARL.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial ownership data (UBO confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after the anniversary of the RBE registration date each year; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be reported within 1 month of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for legal entities from EUR 1,250 to EUR 1,250,000 per breach, and fines for natural persons/managers up to EUR 125,000; each year of non-confirmation constitutes a separate breach, and sustained default may lead to criminal proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax, municipal business tax and net wealth tax returns
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) - Luxembourg Direct Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Electronically due by 31 December of the calendar year following the close of the taxable financial year; a financial year ending 31 December 2024 is due by 31 December 2025.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing permits ex officio tax assessment; late amounts accrue monthly interest of 0.6% and late-payment penalties up to 10%; sustained tax default may lead to enforcement proceedings and court-ordered liquidation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit by an approved réviseur d'entreprises agréé is compulsory if the SARL exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive financial years: total assets EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, average staff of 50 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP as set out in the Law of 19 December 2002, as amended, transposing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; IFRS is permitted for consolidated accounts and may apply in group reporting contexts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every SARL must file an annual confirmation with the RBE no later than one month after the anniversary of its initial UBO registration. A share transfer causing a change in beneficial ownership must be separately filed within one month of the transfer; if no ownership change occurred, the annual confirmation serves as the required nil-return confirmation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - 3,500 per year for Luxembourg registered office address and corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - 18,000 for a typical SARL with bonded transport activities, depending on transaction volume and group structure

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (combined corporate income tax 17%, solidarity surcharge 7% on CIT, and municipal business tax ~6.75% for Luxembourg City)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 80% exemption on qualifying IP income; investment tax credit of up to 8% for eligible assets; participation exemption on dividends and capital gains from qualifying shareholdings (≥10% or ≥€1.2M acquisition cost, held ≥12 months)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 100 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically via MyGuichet.lu
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due by 30 June following the fiscal year-end (if fiscal year = calendar year), extendable to 31 December upon written request

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: name, address, RCS number, tax ID
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide Luxembourg permanent establishment details and foreign tax ID

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before deductions (commercial profit per financial statements)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Luxembourg-source income attributable to PE
Only expenses directly related to Luxembourg PE are deductible

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits (foreign tax credit, investment tax credit)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be positive; losses carried forward separately

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax calculation (CIT, solidarity surcharge, municipal business tax)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply applicable rates and any reduced rates under treaty

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: €10 to €2,500 per month of delay; late payment interest 0.6% per month on unpaid tax, capped at 10% of tax due; criminal sanctions for willful non-filing

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% (reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if parent holds ≥10% for ≥12 months; treaty rates may apply)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: File Form 105 (Application for Withholding Tax Exemption) with Luxembourg tax authorities; submit Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the recipient's country of residence; approval typically within 3 months
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 10% (0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive if beneficial owner is EU resident); Interest: statutory 15% (0% under directive; treaty rates often 0-10%)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if related-party transactions exceed EUR 1,000,000 annually; Master File required if group consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 50,000,000
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) for entities engaged in geographically mobile activities; operational trucking requires physical presence, qualified employees, and decision-making in Luxembourg; failure to meet substance may lead to denial of tax benefits and penalties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of income, falsification of books, or overstatement of deductions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to EUR 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; additional tax penalties up to 100% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for unpaid taxes and penalties; travel bans and asset freezes possible

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: No real economic substance, no employees, no physical office, or artificial arrangements to avoid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax treaty benefits, reclassification of income, penalties up to EUR 50,000; potential criminal charges for fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for fraudulent misrepresentation and may face disqualification from management

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures, lack of suspicious transaction reporting, or involvement in money laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; regulatory license revocation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally fined and banned from management; criminal liability for non-compliance
